dataset: Only films with a reliable nonempty public-description match in the pinned source; removes unmatched/ambiguous films, not a claim that none exist elsewhere
id_and_split: Anonymous contiguous item/user IDs with seed20261106; filter interactions first, then rebuild per-user chronological80/10/10

training.selection: seed42 validation NDCG@10 chooses training settings; other seeds retrain same settings

editors.output: patches only; no hypothesis, rationale, motivation, or explanation requested
editors.feedback: only own candidate identifiers and validation NDCG or generic invalid status

text.conditions: same-model cached title-only or title+public-description representations, subset/reordered to new catalogue; all retained descriptions present

controls.scope: predefined descriptive controls, not a fully matched adaptive search space

evaluation.candidates: full retained catalogue excluding train for valid, train+valid for test
evaluation.groups: training-count tertiles plus zero-item group, computed by evaluator only
evaluation.uncertainty: report independent editor replicates separately from training-seed transfer; paired-user intervals conditional on trained model

freeze: Snapshot patches/assets after each submission; hash every selected policy/model/input before one final test reporting pass. If a fixed patch violates the shared bounds when transferred to another training seed, fall back to original model without reselection and record transfer-invalid status.
interpretation: New filtered cohort and new splits from the same underlying MovieLens corpus; not an untouched external dataset. Old outputs and hypotheses are not supplied to fresh isolated editors. No directional hypotheses or expected effects are stated.
